quest.title: After the Storm
quest.description: After Dvalin was cleansed, access to Stormterror's Lair has been restored. Wagner would like to go there to look for precious Crystal Ore...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Crystal Chunk x12

talks.objective: Go and check for crystal ore in Stormterror's Lair

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: So, did you manage to mine any ore?

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Let me see. Huh. These crystal ores actually don't look half bad.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Here's your payment. Take it for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: So, this means that the storm around Stormterror's Lair has indeed dispersed. I should make time to go there myself soon...

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: There's still much work to be done. I need to put my back into it...
